categories.name: build
categories.evidence: Modifies GitHub Actions workflow actions and CI container scripts in ci/test/ and .github/actions/.
categories.rationale: Separates and caches BSD SDK downloads in GitHub Actions to avoid re-downloading archives from external upstream mirrors when container base image caches miss. This improves BSD CI build times and prevents job failures caused by unresponsive upstream mirrors.

categories.name: tests
categories.evidence: Carries the Tests label, but changes only CI container setup and GitHub Actions caching scripts.
categories.rationale: The PR exclusively modifies CI workflow actions and container build scripts covered under Build and CI, rather than test harnesses, framework utilities, or individual test suites.
